speaker: Doctor
text: I understand you're experiencing generalized fatigue, severe itching, and abnormal liver function tests. To begin narrowing this down, have you noticed any changes in your urine color, such as it appearing dark like tea, or pale stools? Also, have you experienced any jaundice, which would present as yellowing of your skin or eyes?

speaker: Patient
text: 32-year-old male. The patient reports a 2-month history of increasing generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. He has known hypertension and was diagnosed with ulcerative colitis 5 years ago. He mentions being sexually active with 2 female partners and inconsistent condom use.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for those details; given your history of ulcerative colitis and recent sexual activity, we must rule out opportunistic infections or drug-induced liver injury. Have you recently started any new medications, particularly for your colitis or blood pressure, or experienced any abdominal pain or weight loss? Also, have you noticed any rash or fever alongside the itching?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. I also have Scleral icterus, Multiple scratch marks on trunk and extremities.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Primary Biliary Cholangitis (PBC).

The presence of scleral icterus, severe pruritus, fatigue, and your history of autoimmune disease (ulcerative colitis) strongly suggests an autoimmune cholestatic disorder. REQUEST TEST: Serum Antimitochondrial Antibody (AMA). REQUEST IMAGES: Liver Ultrasound.
